title: Final Answers for c_v
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify and state c_v as (5/2)nR.

title: Final Answers for c_p
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify and state c_p as (7/2)nR.

title: Energy Density Comparison
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the energy density U/V in terms of pressure p.

title: Correct Derivation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct derivation of U from the entropy equation.

title: Use of Ideal Gas Law
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the ideal gas law in the context of energy density.

title: Temperature Conversion
description: Optional Criteria: The student may convert temperatures from Fahrenheit to Kelvin or Celsius for clarity.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the derivation of specific heats.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that units are consistent throughout the calculations.
